decisions.label: Remove the first section header
decisions.why: "CACFP Monthly Update" repeats the page title, so the reader is told the same thing twice before any content.

decisions.label: Use this paragraph as the page description
decisions.why: It is the page’s own opening paragraph, moved into the banner rather than rewritten.
decisions.value: The Child and Adult Care Food Program (CACFP) Monthly Update covers claim submissions, training opportunities, meal pattern resources, harvest of the month, and more. Browse the archive below.

decisions.label: Let a column of short entries keep them on one line
decisions.why: 1 column holds nothing longer than sixteen characters and sits in a table that also has a column of paragraphs. The layout sizes a column by its longest unbreakable run, so "Step 1" asks only for the width of "Step" and the paragraph column takes the rest — which is how "Step" and "1" end up on separate lines in a column with room to spare beside it. Held on one line, the column asks for what it needs. Nothing is widened by force and no word changes.
